Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor in construction works of at least 1(One) contract(s) of the minimum
value of the similar nature, complexity and methods/construction technology successfully completed within the last 10(ten) years,
each with a value of at least BDT.Tk. 40 (Forty) Crore. Years counting back ward from the date of publication of IFT in e-Gp portal.
The Contractor shall have the following experience in the above Mentioned and other contract :
(i) Must have experience of Constructing building with Minimum two Basements.
(ii) Construction of Cast-in-situ RCC Pile of Minimum dia 400mm and a Length of 30M or More
(iii) Cast in situ pile must be done by using hydraulic Rotary pilling Rig. Machine.
(iv) All RCC casting must be done by using Ready Mix Concrete plant.
(v) Mechanical hydraulic pressure machine must be used for pre-cast pile driven
2. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk. 67.00 (Sixty Seven) Crore in the last 5 (Five) years.
Payment certificates for contract in progress or completed under public sector during last 5 (five) years must be submitted along
with the tender in support of average annual construction turnover.
3. Liquid assets/ working capital/credit facilities Tk. 60.00 (Sixty) Crore.
4. The Tender Capacity is Tk. 52.00 (Fifty Two) Crore. Supporting document must be submitted along with information as per
enclosed form (ongoing works/commitments)
5. The Tenderer must enclose up-to-date Trade license, Income Tax clearance certificate, VAT registration certificate and up-to-
date ABC Contractor and Supervisory License.
6. Personnel Capacity & Equipment Capacity as per TDS.
Brief Description of Works : Construction of 05 storied Building with 10 storied foundation having two Basement Floor including Civil, Sanitary and Internal
Electrification works.
